description: Search SBGrid3.0 grid API and option documentation by keyword. Returns matching entries with name, summary, syntax, and category. Start here to find which API/option fits a task, then call getSBGridAPIDetail for full details or getSBGridExample for code. [Regular grid only — SBGrid3.createGrid: row lists, editing, sorting, filtering, grouping, paging, excel. If the requirement is a PIVOT / cross-tab summary (rows x columns x aggregated values), use the SBPivot tools (searchSBPivotAPI etc.) instead — it is a different grid.] ⚠️ SBGrid3 코드/샘플 생성 시 서버 공통지침(요청 범위의 제품 기능 우선 · 표준 골격과 columns/gridConfig 명시 · HTML 병행 이유 설명 · 불필요한 기능 추가 금지) 준수 — 상세는 서버 instructions 참고.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 5.

query.description: Keyword to search: a feature, option, or method name (e.g. 'excelExport', 'filter', 'column width', 'row grouping').

name: searchSBGridAPI
